items.en: Yokohama is celebrating a successful debut season as an official partner of BMW M Motorsport, after the #77 Schubert Motorsport BMW M4 GT3 EVO secured the overall NLS Speed Trophy series championship. Equipped with Yokohama’s global flagship Advan racing tyres, the #77 car accumulated the most points across all classes throughout the Nürburgring Langstrecken-Serie (NLS) season in Germany. By clinching the top spot in the premier SP9 Pro class, the team also won the KW Team Trophy for its class.

The Tire Industry Project (TIP) has released its latest annual key performance indicator (KPI) report, showcasing measurable progress in decarbonisation, water efficiency, and responsible sourcing across the global tyre sector. Titled Sustainability Driven: Key Performance Indicators for TIP Members 2021-2025, the report details the collective efforts of ten of the world’s largest tyre manufacturers against 16 environmental, social and governance (ESG) metrics tied to the UN Sustainable Development Goals.
The announcement places particular emphasis on the role of workshop equipment and technical support in helping garages maintain vehicles in a safe and roadworthy condition (Photo: Straightset)

Garage equipment supplier Straightset has become a commercial supporter of TyreSafe, joining the charity’s efforts to improve tyre maintenance awareness and reduce tyre-related incidents on UK roads. The partnership also involves Supertracker, the British wheel alignment equipment manufacturer that has been part of Straightset since 2022.
